svg.title: Business-Process Architecture — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: High-level BPMN architecture with six Charles River responsibility lanes for goods sales, purchasing, production, Design Services, payroll, and finance. Each independently triggered path contains a collapsed subprocess and its own end; customer demand is communicated from a separate pool.

div.div:
Shared master data, purchasing support, production output, labor and ledger records connect these cycles. Their business dependencies are explained in prose and Mermaid.
An end here means scoped activity is recorded, not that every order, invoice or liability is settled. No global parallel join forces all cycles to finish before financial reporting.
